skill.summary: 阿里云实时搜索 | Aliyun Real-time Web Search with Quark Engine

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of aliyun-web-search skill.

- Supports real-time Chinese web search using Aliyun Open Search Platform with Quark search engine.
- Easy configuration guide for API activation, API key setup, and service URL by region.
- Flexible options for result count, time range, and advanced filters.
- Provides troubleshooting, usage examples, and security best practices.
- Designed for integration with OpenClaw, including full environment variable setup.
